issues: Recharts logs multiple warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' before responsive container measures. Cosmetic console warning, not user-visible; consider setting explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 842 lines with all routes in one file — consider splitting into routers per module (auth, employees, attendance, payroll, etc.) for maintainability.

CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True (from env default) — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Since app uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) this works, but explicit origins recommended.
server.py:521 bulk_attendance calls mark_attendance in a loop with per-item awaits — acceptable for demo scale but not batched.
auth.py: get_current_user falls back to cookies but there's no CSRF protection; since primary transport is Bearer this is OK.
startup event seeds demo data on every process start — idempotent via replace/upsert should be verified for CI reruns.
